data.description: Burj and Fountain View | Majestic 3BR+Maids Room
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this exceptional 3-bedroom apartment with a maid's room in one of Downtown Dubai's most prestigious communities. Located on the highly sought-after 08 Series above the 45th floor, this upgraded residence boasts breathtaking panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain, and the Downtown skyline.

Offered at AED 299,000 per annum, this fully furnished home features a spacious open-plan living and dining area with floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing abundant natural light and spectacular city views. A modern fully equipped kitchen, premium finishes, and elegant interiors complete this luxurious residence.

Property Features:

3 Bedrooms + Maid's Room
High Floor – 08 Series (Above 45th Floor)
Full Burj Khalifa & Dubai Fountain Views
Built-up Area: 1,646 sq.ft.
Fully Furnished & Upgraded
Spacious Living & Dining Area
Fully Equipped Modern Kitchen
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows

Prime Location:

Walking Distance to Dubai Mall
Walking Distance to Burj Khalifa & Dubai Fountain
Walking Distance to Dubai Opera & Downtown Boulevard
5 Minutes to Business Bay
10 Minutes to DIFC
15 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
Easy Access to Sheikh Zayed Road & Al Khail Road

Offering the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this remarkable home is ideal for families and professionals looking to enjoy an exceptional lifestyle in the heart of Downtown Dubai.
